idea: Today is a **review day**: no new grammar. We pull together Days 14-19 so you can talk about yourself in 10 short sentences.
## The 9 verb forms (present tense of पठ्)
A verb's **person** says who does it (he/she, you, I); its **number** says how many: one (singular), two (dual) or three-plus (plural). Hindi has no dual; Sanskrit does.
- he/she: पठति, those two: पठतः, they: पठन्ति
- you: पठसि, you two: पठथः, you all: पठथ
- I: पठामि, we two: पठावः, we all: पठामः
Every verb you know works the same way: गच्छामि, खादसि, वदन्ति, धावथः, हसावः.
## Pronouns and question words
- सः/सा he/she; एषः/एषा this one (m/f); कः/का who? (m/f); किम् what?
- अहम् I, त्वम् you; मम my, तव your
- कुत्र where, कदा when, कथम् how, किमर्थम् why, कति how many
- अस्ति is, नास्ति is not; आम् yes, न no/not
## New today: अस्मि and असि
अस्ति (is) has partners: **अहं ... अस्मि** = I am, **त्वं ... असि** = you are. So: अहं छात्रः अस्मि = मैं छात्र हूँ.
Careful writers join छात्रः + अस्मि into छात्रोऽस्मि (sound-joining, sandhi, Day 53). In simple modern Sanskrit, writing them apart is fine.
Video note: the speaker may say the final a the Hindi way (नाम as 'naam'). Say nā-ma, with the final a.
## Speaking task: 10 sentences about yourself
Write 10 sentences, then read them aloud twice. Use these models; change the words to fit you:
- 1 नमस्ते। मम नाम ___।
- 2 अहं छात्रः अस्मि। (a woman says छात्रा)
- 3 अहं संस्कृतं पठामि।
- 4 अहं प्रतिदिनं पठामि।
- 5 अहं कार्यालयं गच्छामि।
- 6 मम माता ___ । (what does she do? पठति, वदति, हसति ...)
- 8 मम मित्रम् अत्र नास्ति।
- 9 अद्य अहं ___ खादामि।
- 10 किं त्वं संस्कृतं पठसि? आम्!
Send your 10 sentences with your quiz answers and I'll correct every one.

examples.dev: तव नाम किम्? मम नाम सीता।
examples.iast: tava nāma kim? mama nāma sītā.
examples.meaning: What is your name? My name is Sita.
Who (female) is laughing? This girl is laughing.

sayAloud.dev: अहं छात्रः अस्मि। अहं प्रतिदिनं संस्कृतं पठामि।
sayAloud.iast: ahaṃ chātraḥ asmi. ahaṃ pratidinaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ paṭhāmi.
sayAloud.meaning: I am a student. I study Sanskrit every day.

sayAloud.dev: त्वं कुत्र गच्छसि? अहं कार्यालयं गच्छामि।
sayAloud.iast: tvaṃ kutra gacchasi? ahaṃ kāryālayaṃ gacchāmi.
sayAloud.meaning: Where are you going? I am going to the office.
Your own day: one sentence, e.g. अद्य अहं भोजनं खादामि। (Today I eat a meal.)

quiz.q: Which verb form goes with आवाम् (we two)?
quiz.why: आवाम् (we two) takes the dual -आवः. गच्छामः is 'we all'; गच्छथः is 'you two'.

quiz.q: Fill in the blank: अहं छात्रा ___। (I am a student.)
quiz.why: With अहम् (I), 'am' is अस्मि. अस्ति is for he/she/it; असि for you.
का = who, for a female; कः = who, for a male; किम् = what.

quiz.q: Which sentence means 'Why are you laughing?'
quiz.why: किमर्थम् = why (क्यों). कथम् = how; कदा = when.

quiz.q: Translate into Sanskrit: My father is not here.
